_comment: Events already in the DB under an old source's name (ennead / Fandom). While such an event runs, the scraper's name is replaced by dbName before the DB check, so it isn't inserted twice. Entry: { "gameId": 5, "sourceName": "name on the scraped site", "dbName": "name in the DB" }. Exact names, case-insensitive. The shadow report lists candidates. Remove an entry once its event has ended.
